items.reason: Own homepage: 'Early-stage specialist for cyber, cloud, AI' and 'Institutional-Grade Venture Capital'; self_reported true and tier 2 are correct.

CzechCrunch 2024-06-13 quote is verbatim and about Tachles VC: it targets cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure and AI. The mapping to cybersecurity_defense and ai_data is correct, and cloud is left unmapped.

Article (2025-02-12) lists Hirundo among 'Loni zainvestované projekty Tachles VC', so Tachles is an investor. But this recaps 2024 deals with no dates, so it may predate WINDOW_START 2024-10-11. USD 7.6M is the total of two rounds, not Tachles' ticket.

record_opinion.reason: Tachles is clearly an early-stage VC: 7 investments in 2024, and the site lists later portfolio companies. But no cited item has a dated deal clearly within 24 months. Team country is also unclear: CzechCrunch calls it a Czech fund with Czech founders (Tusek, Marek), while the website shows a US (Peachtree Corners, GA) address and partners in Israel and the US.
